name: Baskets and Blooms
summary: Baskets and Blooms is a cozy, single-player farming and farmer's market simulation game. Players cultivate crops, forage wild flora, and craft goods to build and customize their own market stall. Designed with a focus on relaxed gameplay and deep systems, the game features a dynamic, demand-driven economy that shifts with the seasons, grid-based farming, and a town of NPC customers with evolving preferences and relationships.
